name: Azure Backup
short_description: Azure Backup is Microsoft's managed cloud backup service that protects Azure VMs, databases, file shares, blobs, disks and on-premises servers, storing recovery points in a vault with policy-based retention.

evidence.quote: As your backup changes that equation, no tapes, no on-prem servers, no crossed fingers.
use Azure backup to store copies in a recovery services vault.
Many people think Azure site recovery and Azure backup are basically the same thing they're not.
